The alert goes to ops-team@example.com and the host is 10.20.30.40. Find out why the preflight rejects it.

content.text: The preflight script compares the local environment with the values injected by the deploy job. I should read the script and print the environment before I change anything. The host 10.20.30.40 may be missing from the allowlist.

`scripts/preflight.js` rejects any host outside the deploy allowlist. `10.20.30.40` is absent from `config/hosts.json`, so the job stops before it copies the bundle. Add the host to the allowlist, then rerun `npm run preflight`.

$ sed -n '1,24p' .env
NODE_ENV=production
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-Example9Fake2Key7Value4For1Tests6Only
GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_ExampleFakeToken1234567890ABCDEFGHIJ
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAEXAMPLEFAKE12345
AWS_REGION=us-east-1
DEPLOY_HOST=10.20.30.40
DEPLOY_USER=deploy-bot
ALERT_EMAIL=ops-team@example.com
LOG_LEVEL=info
RETRY_LIMIT=3
TIMEOUT_MS=45000
